verdict.rationale: Stable documents webhook endpoints that you configure in the Dashboard to receive notifications about account events (stable-docs-4). Its onboarding guide says progress can be monitored via webhooks (stable-docs-47), and the product and pricing pages list 'API and webhooks' as included (stable-docs-60, stable-docs-63). The docs still suggest polling GET /v1/locations/{id} for registered-agent status changes (stable-docs-49), which hints that event coverage may be incomplete. missing for 10: a documented event-type catalog and payload schemas, signature verification and retry semantics, API-based (non-dashboard) webhook registration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
